note: authored after reading the frozen corpus and before any of these questions was run through the index

queries.question: How many points is a city worth if one of the yellow gates is sitting on it?
evidence: worth a total of 4 victory points

queries.question: None of my hexes paid out on my roll. Is there anything that still lets me take something?
evidence: do not receive any resources or commodities

queries.question: Do I get anything extra while I'm holding the little wooden cone?
evidence: receive 1 victory point for as long as you control the merchant

queries.question: Do stronger soldiers need more grain to get ready for action?
evidence: does not affect the cost to activate it

queries.question: Can I ever get a mighty knight onto the board without having built the Fortress?
evidence: even if you have not yet built

queries.question: Do I need a knight of my own to displace an opponent's knight?
evidence: without using a knight of your own

queries.question: What if several players tie for the biggest knight army after we beat the barbarians?
evidence: no player is declared defender of catan

queries.question: Which production numbers am I not allowed to swap when I move number tokens around?
Can I use two cards that cut the price of one city improvement on the same upgrade?
Can I raid the hand of a player who is behind me on points?
evidence: only play this card on an opponent who has more victory points than you

queries.question: Do all of the players have to agree before one of the optional rules is used?
evidence: strictly optional and should only be used if agreed on by all players

queries.question: Can the robber stop me from using the merchant's cheaper trades?
evidence: the robber does not affect the merchant

queries.question: With two cities that each have a wall, how many cards can I keep when a seven comes up?
How many ship faces are on the event die?
evidence: 1 event die (with 3 ships and 3 city gate symbols)

queries.question: How strong are the barbarians when they land?
evidence: strength of the barbarians is equal to the number of cities

queries.question: Can a settlement next to a pasture hex give me cloth?
evidence: commodities are produced only by cities
